headline: Pertalite to Be Restricted for Certain Deciles, Here's How to Check Online, Just Enter NIK
summary: The Indonesian government is studying restrictions on subsidised Pertalite fuel for deciles 9 and 10. Households can check their decile position online by entering their national ID number.
why: Pertalite is a subsidised gasoline grade in Indonesia, and subsidy policy affects state budget spending and fuel demand. Changes to eligibility can alter fuel consumption and government fiscal costs.
